ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious PowerShell Encoded Command Patterns
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects PowerShell command line patterns in combincation with encoded commands that often appear in malware infection chains

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\.Exe" OR process_original_file_name = "pwsh\.dll")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-e\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-en\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-enc\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-enco.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ JAB.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ SUVYI.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ SQBFAFgA.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ aWV4I.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ IAB.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ PAA.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ aQBlAHgA.*"))) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Packages\\\\Plugins\\\\Microsoft\\\.GuestConfiguration\\\.ConfigurationforWindows\\\\.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\gc\\_worker\\\.exe.*")))
